thesis: collectHookFeesByHook reentrancy during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers allows double-withdrawal of hook fees
reason: tokensOwed decremented before safeTransfer (checks-effects-interactions). Re-entrant call for same key underflows and reverts.

thesis: Flash loan callback reads stale reserves, enabling arbitrage against the AMM's own state
reason: No AMM-internal function compares balanceOf to reserves during callback. External integrator issue only (Tier C).

thesis: Multi-hop swap intermediate state allows cross-pool state manipulation between hops
reason: Each hop updates reserves independently. Pools have isolated state. No cross-hop stale read.

thesis: _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) during hook fee execution creates unguarded window for state-modifying re-entry
reason: ENTERED bit preserved (lines 68-72 mask out ENTERED/NOT_ENTERED from input). Core functions all check ENTERED bit via nonReentrant/nonReentrantWithFlags.

thesis: Malicious pool type via delegatecall corrupts diamond storage slots
reason: Pool types called via external call (not delegatecall). Isolated storage. Address restricted to 6 leading zero bytes.

thesis: Fee denomination mismatch in _storeHookFees allows amplified fee extraction
reason: hookFeeKey encodes both tokenFor and tokenFee. Amount denominated in tokenFee. _transferHookFeesByHook uses same key with tokenFee as transfer token. No mismatch.
